q: Which country is known as the 'Land of White Elephants'?
e: Thailand is called the Land of White Elephants, as white elephants are revered there and figure on its historic symbols.

q: Which country is known as the 'Sugar Bowl of the World'?
e: Cuba is called the Sugar Bowl of the World because sugarcane and sugar have long dominated its production and exports.

q: Cairo is the capital of:
e: Cairo is the capital of Egypt, situated on the Nile.

q: Abuja is the capital of:
e: Abuja is the capital of Nigeria, replacing Lagos as the federal capital.

q: National Technology Day in India, marking the anniversary of the Pokhran nuclear tests of 1998, is observed every year on:
e: National Technology Day is observed on 11 May, marking the Pokhran nuclear tests conducted on that day in 1998.

q: The Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR), the Navratna public sector undertaking engaged in containerised rail transport, was incorporated in the year:
e: CONCOR was incorporated in 1988 to take over containerised rail transport, and later became a Navratna PSU.

q: The 'Rail Madad' platform of Indian Railways primarily enables rail passengers to:

options.B: Lodge complaints and track the redressal of their grievances
options.C: Order food for delivery on trains

e: Rail Madad is the unified platform where passengers lodge complaints and track redressal of their grievances.

q: The 'NIVARAN' online portal of Indian Railways is a grievance-redressal system meant primarily for:
e: NIVARAN is the online grievance-redressal portal meant primarily for serving and retired railway employees.

q: Mahanadi Coalfields Railway Limited, a special purpose vehicle set up for developing rail infrastructure for the evacuation of coal in Odisha, is a joint venture of Mahanadi Coalfields Limited and IRCON with:
e: Mahanadi Coalfields Railway Limited is a joint venture of MCL and IRCON with the Government of Odisha for coal evacuation lines.

q: The Regional Rail Museum, the second rail museum set up by Indian Railways, is located at:
e: The Regional Rail Museum at Howrah was the second rail museum set up by Indian Railways, after the National Rail Museum.

q: The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Limited (DMRC), which built and operates the metro rail network of the National Capital Region, was incorporated in the year:
e: DMRC was incorporated in 1995 to build and operate the Delhi Metro network in the National Capital Region.

q: The corporate headquarters of the Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR), the Navratna public sector undertaking engaged in containerised rail transport, is located at:
e: The corporate headquarters of CONCOR is located at New Delhi.

q: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL), the special purpose vehicle executing the Mumbai-Ahmedabad high speed rail corridor, was incorporated in the year:
e: NHSRCL, the SPV for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad high speed rail corridor, was incorporated in 2016.

q: The Railway Recruitment Cells (RRCs), set up at the headquarters of each zonal railway, are entrusted with the recruitment of staff for:
e: Railway Recruitment Cells at zonal headquarters conduct recruitment for Level-1, erstwhile Group D, posts.

q: The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL), the special purpose vehicle set up to build and operate the dedicated freight corridors, was incorporated in the year:
e: DFCCIL, the SPV for building and operating dedicated freight corridors, was incorporated in 2006.

q: The corporate office of RailTel Corporation of India Limited, the public sector undertaking providing broadband and telecom services on the railway network, is located at:
e: The corporate office of RailTel Corporation of India Limited is located at Gurugram, Haryana.

q: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL), the public sector undertaking executing rail infrastructure projects on a fast-track basis, was incorporated in the year:
e: RVNL was incorporated in 2003 to execute rail infrastructure projects on a fast-track basis.

q: The Divisional Railway Users' Consultative Committee (DRUCC) of a railway division is chaired by the:

options.A: General Manager of the zonal railway

e: The DRUCC of a division is chaired by the Divisional Railway Manager, the head of that division.

q: The Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited (IRCTC), the public sector undertaking handling e-ticketing, catering and tourism services of Indian Railways, was incorporated in the year:
e: IRCTC was incorporated in 1999 to handle e-ticketing, catering and tourism services of Indian Railways.

q: The headquarters of the Central Organisation for Railway Electrification (CORE), which executes electrification projects of Indian Railways, is located at:
e: The headquarters of the Central Organisation for Railway Electrification (CORE) is at Prayagraj.

q: The National Rail Museum at Chanakyapuri in New Delhi, which preserves and displays the heritage of Indian Railways, was opened to the public in the year:
e: The National Rail Museum at Chanakyapuri, New Delhi, was opened to the public in 1977.

q: The Indian Railways Institute of Financial Management (IRIFM) at Secunderabad, the centralised training institute for the officers of the railway accounts service, was inaugurated in the year:
e: IRIFM at Secunderabad, the training institute for railway accounts officers, was inaugurated in 2019.

q: The Commission of Railway Safety, which carries out inspectorial and investigatory functions relating to the safety of rail travel, functions under the administrative control of the:

options.C: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

e: The Commission of Railway Safety functions under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, keeping it independent of the Railways.

q: The Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya at Vadodara, the central university dedicated to the transport and logistics sector, functions under the aegis of the:

options.C: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
options.D: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

e: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya at Vadodara functions under the aegis of the Ministry of Railways.

q: The Rail Wheel Factory at Bengaluru, which manufactures wheels, axles and wheel sets for Indian Railways, was earlier known by the name:
e: The Rail Wheel Factory at Bengaluru was earlier known as the Wheel and Axle Plant before its present name.

q: The Railway Workshop at Kalka in Haryana, which undertakes the overhaul of the narrow gauge rolling stock of the Kalka-Shimla section, functions under the:
e: The Kalka workshop, overhauling Kalka-Shimla narrow gauge stock, lies in Northern Railway territory and functions under it.

q: The Carriage Repair Workshop at Tirupati in Andhra Pradesh, which undertakes the periodic overhaul of passenger coaches, functions under the:
e: The Carriage Repair Workshop at Tirupati functions under South Central Railway, in whose jurisdiction it lies.

q: The ancillary unit of the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, which manufactures electric locomotives at Dankuni, is located in the State of:
e: CLW's ancillary electric loco unit at Dankuni is located in West Bengal, the same state as Chittaranjan.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Visakhapatnam, reputed to be the largest diesel locomotive shed of Indian Railways, functions under the:
e: The Visakhapatnam Diesel Loco Shed now functions under the Visakhapatnam division of the South Coast Railway, the zone operational from 1 June 2026; it earlier worked under East Coast Railway through the Waltair division.

q: The Carriage and Wagon Works at Perambur in Chennai, which undertakes the overhaul and repair of coaches and wagons, is a workshop of the:
e: The Carriage and Wagon Works at Perambur, Chennai, is a workshop of Southern Railway.

q: The Wagon Repair Workshop at Kazipet, which undertakes the periodic overhaul of freight wagons, is located in the State of:
e: Kazipet is in Telangana, so the Wagon Repair Workshop there is located in that state.

q: The East Central Railway, with its headquarters at Hajipur, came into existence as a separate zonal railway in the year:
e: East Central Railway, headquartered at Hajipur, came into existence as a separate zone in 2002, when it became operational.

q: The West Central Railway, with its headquarters at Jabalpur, came into existence as a separate zonal railway in the year:
e: West Central Railway, headquartered at Jabalpur, came into existence as a separate zone in 2003.

q: The Mechanical Workshop at Gorakhpur, which undertakes the overhaul of coaches and wagons, is a workshop of the:
e: The Mechanical Workshop at Gorakhpur is a workshop of North Eastern Railway, whose headquarters is at Gorakhpur.

q: In railway labour relations, 'PREM', the forum for the participation of railway staff in management, stands for:

options.A: Participation of Railway Executives in Management
options.B: Participation of Railway Employees in Management

e: PREM stands for Participation of Railway Employees in Management, the forum for staff participation in management.

q: In Indian Railways, 'IRTS', one of the organised Group 'A' services, stands for:
e: IRTS stands for Indian Railway Traffic Service, the Group A service for transportation and commercial working.

q: In Indian Railways, 'IRPS', one of the organised Group 'A' services, stands for:
e: IRPS stands for Indian Railway Personnel Service, the Group A service for personnel and establishment matters.

q: In Indian Railways, 'IRSE', one of the organised Group 'A' services, stands for:
e: IRSE stands for Indian Railway Service of Engineers, the Group A civil engineering service of the Railways.

q: In Indian Railways, 'IRSEE', one of the organised Group 'A' services, stands for:

options.A: Indian Railway Service of Engineering Executives
options.B: Indian Railway Service of Electrical Engineers
options.C: Indian Railway Secretariat of Electrical Engineers
options.D: Indian Railway Service of Electronics Engineers

e: IRSEE stands for Indian Railway Service of Electrical Engineers, the Group A electrical engineering service.

q: In railway rolling stock, 'CBC', the coupling used in modern LHB coaches and freight wagons, stands for:
e: CBC stands for Centre Buffer Coupler, the coupling used in modern LHB coaches and freight wagons.

q: In passenger services of Indian Railways, 'OBHS', the facility for cleaning of coaches and toilets during the run of a train, stands for:
e: OBHS stands for On Board Housekeeping Service, providing cleaning of coaches and toilets during the train run.

q: In unreserved ticketing on Indian Railways, 'JTBS', the private agents authorised to sell unreserved tickets outside station premises, stands for:
e: JTBS stands for Jansadharan Ticket Booking Sevak, the agents authorised to sell unreserved tickets outside stations.

q: In passenger ticketing on Indian Railways, 'YTSK', the licensees authorised to sell reserved e-tickets, stands for:
e: YTSK stands for Yatri Ticket Suvidha Kendra, the licensees authorised to sell reserved e-tickets.

q: In train ticket checking on Indian Railways, 'HHT', the device used by the ticket checking staff for checking reserved tickets and allotting vacant berths, stands for:
e: HHT stands for Hand Held Terminal, used by ticket checking staff to check tickets and allot vacant berths.

q: At a zonal railway headquarters of Indian Railways, the designation 'PCME', borne by the head of the mechanical department, stands for:
e: PCME stands for Principal Chief Mechanical Engineer, the head of the mechanical department at zonal headquarters.

q: The Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL) project, which connected the Kashmir Valley with the rest of the country by rail, has a total length of about:
e: The USBRL project connecting the Kashmir Valley by rail has a total length of about 272 km.

q: The Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya at Vadodara was established as a Central University in the year:
e: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya was established as a Central University in 2022, converted from the earlier railway university.

q: The 'One Station One Product' scheme of Indian Railways, which provides a showcase for local and indigenous products at railway stations, was announced in the Union Budget for the year:
e: The One Station One Product scheme was announced in the Union Budget for 2022-23 to showcase local products at stations.

q: The Rail Kaushal Vikas Yojana, under which short-term skill training is imparted to the youth at railway training institutes, was launched in the year:
e: Rail Kaushal Vikas Yojana, giving short-term skill training to youth at railway institutes, was launched in 2021.

q: The PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan for multi-modal connectivity, under which railway infrastructure projects are planned in coordination with other modes of transport, was launched in the month of:
e: The PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan for multi-modal connectivity was launched in October 2021.

q: The first electric train service in the Kashmir Valley, flagged off in February 2024, was run on the section between:
e: The first electric train in the Kashmir Valley, in February 2024, ran on the Sangaldan-Baramulla section of USBRL.

q: The first 'UDAY' (Utkrisht Double Decker Air Conditioned Yatri) Express service of Indian Railways, introduced in 2018, was run between:
e: The first UDAY double-decker express, introduced in 2018, ran between Coimbatore and Bengaluru.

q: Under 'Mission Raftaar' of Indian Railways, the average speed of freight trains was targeted to be raised to:
e: Mission Raftaar targeted raising the average speed of freight trains to 50 kmph, alongside faster passenger services.

q: The much-publicised head-on trial run of the 'Kavach' automatic train protection system, conducted in March 2022, was carried out on a section of the:
e: The Kavach head-on trial run of March 2022 was conducted on a section of South Central Railway.

q: The first phase of the Aqua Line, the first underground metro rail corridor of Mumbai, inaugurated in October 2024, was opened for public service between:

options.B: Aarey Colony and Bandra Kurla Complex

e: Phase one of Mumbai's Aqua Line opened in October 2024 between Aarey Colony and Bandra Kurla Complex.

q: The Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) was granted the 'Navratna' status by the Government of India in the year:
e: IRFC was granted Navratna status in 2025, upgrading it from its earlier Miniratna category.

q: The Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC), the dedicated market-borrowing arm of Indian Railways, is registered with the Reserve Bank of India as a:
e: IRFC is registered with the RBI as a Non-Banking Financial Company in the Infrastructure Finance Company category.

q: The Madhepura Electric Locomotive Private Limited (MELPL), which manufactures high-power electric locomotives at Madhepura in Bihar, is a joint venture of Indian Railways with:
e: MELPL at Madhepura is a joint venture of Indian Railways with Alstom, which supplies the high-power electric locomotives.

q: The Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor, being implemented by DFCCIL from Ludhiana to Dankuni, is being executed with loan assistance mainly from the:
e: The Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor from Ludhiana to Dankuni is funded mainly with World Bank loan assistance.

q: The Indian Railway Stations Development Corporation (IRSDC), set up for the redevelopment of railway stations, was closed down by the Railway Board in the year:
e: IRSDC, set up for station redevelopment, was closed down by the Railway Board in 2021 as part of rightsizing.

q: The common Foundation Course for the probationer officers of all the organised Group 'A' services of Indian Railways is conducted at the:

options.A: National Academy of Indian Railways, Vadodara
options.B: Indian Railways Institute of Transport Management, Lucknow
options.C: Indian Railways Institute of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications, Secunderabad
options.D: Centralised Training Academy for Railway Accounts, Secunderabad

e: The common Foundation Course for probationers of all railway Group A services is conducted at NAIR, Vadodara.

q: After the restructuring of the Railway Board in 2020, the infrastructure function, covering works and civil engineering, is headed in the Board by the:
e: After the 2020 Railway Board restructuring, works and civil engineering come under the Member (Infrastructure).

q: The Railway Staff College at Vadodara was renamed as the National Academy of Indian Railways (NAIR) in the year:
e: The Railway Staff College at Vadodara was renamed the National Academy of Indian Railways in 1985.

q: The Artificial Intelligence based chatbot of IRCTC, which answers the ticketing and catering related queries of passengers, is named:
e: AskDisha is IRCTC's AI-based chatbot answering passengers' ticketing and catering related queries.

q: The 'Coach-Mitra' service, through which passengers on trains can request on-board housekeeping services such as coach cleaning, is provided by the:

options.A: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC)

e: Coach-Mitra, for requesting on-board housekeeping like coach cleaning, is provided by IRCTC.

q: At the Central Government level, the metro rail projects of Indian cities are administered by the:

options.B: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
options.C: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

e: At the Centre, metro rail projects are administered by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, not the Railways.

q: The Metro Rail Policy, which lays down the framework for the implementation of metro rail projects in Indian cities, was approved by the Union Cabinet in the year:
e: The Metro Rail Policy laying down the framework for city metro projects was approved by the Cabinet in 2017.

q: The Railway Staff College, now functioning as the National Academy of Indian Railways, was shifted from Dehradun to Vadodara in the year:
e: The Railway Staff College was shifted from Dehradun to Vadodara in 1952, where NAIR now functions.

q: The Indian Railway Conference Association (IRCA), the long-standing body associated with inter-railway coordination of commercial and operating matters, was closed down by the Railway Board in the year:
e: IRCA, the body for inter-railway commercial and operating coordination, was closed down by the Railway Board in 2022.

q: The railway station with the longest name in India, 'Venkatanarasimharajuvaripeta', is located in the State of:
e: Venkatanarasimharajuvaripeta, India's longest station name, is located in Andhra Pradesh.

q: The Electric Loco Assembly and Ancillary Unit of the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW) in West Bengal is located at:
e: The Electric Loco Assembly and Ancillary Unit of CLW in West Bengal is located at Dankuni.

q: The Sharavathi Bridge, the longest railway bridge on the Konkan Railway route, is located in the State of:
e: The Sharavathi Bridge, the longest railway bridge on the Konkan route, crosses the Sharavathi river in Karnataka.

q: The Jamalpur Workshop of Eastern Railway, one of the oldest railway workshops of India, is located in which district of Bihar?
e: The Jamalpur Workshop of Eastern Railway is located in Munger district of Bihar.

q: The Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus building at Mumbai, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, was designed by the British architectural engineer:
e: The CSMT building at Mumbai, a UNESCO heritage site, was designed by British engineer Frederick William Stevens.

q: 'Metro Rail Bhavan' at Kolkata is the headquarters building of the:
e: Metro Rail Bhavan at Kolkata is the headquarters building of the Metro Railway, Kolkata.

q: The East Coast Railway, with headquarters at Bhubaneswar, came into existence as a zonal railway in the year:
e: East Coast Railway, headquartered at Bhubaneswar, came into existence as a zonal railway in 2003.

q: The Karbude Tunnel, the longest tunnel on the Konkan Railway route, is located in the State of:
e: The Karbude Tunnel, the longest tunnel on the Konkan Railway route, is located in Maharashtra.

q: The Diesel Loco Modernisation Works (DMW) at Patiala was renamed as the Patiala Locomotive Works (PLW) in the year:
e: DMW at Patiala was renamed Patiala Locomotive Works in 2022, after it switched to electric loco production.

q: The Aurangabad railway station of Maharashtra was officially renamed in October 2025 as:
e: Aurangabad station was officially renamed Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in October 2025, matching the city's new name.

q: In the family of railway production units, 'ICF' stands for:
e: ICF stands for Integral Coach Factory, the Perambur production unit building integrated-design coaches.

q: In the family of railway production units, 'CLW' stands for:
e: CLW stands for Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, the electric locomotive production unit at Chittaranjan.

q: 'IRPS', an organised Group 'A' service of Indian Railways, stands for:
e: IRPS stands for Indian Railway Personnel Service, the Group A service dealing with personnel matters.

q: 'IRSE', an organised Group 'A' service of Indian Railways, stands for:
e: IRSE stands for Indian Railway Service of Engineers, the Group A civil engineering service of Indian Railways.

q: In railway suburban commercial working, a 'QST', the season ticket issued for a period of three months, stands for:
e: QST stands for Quarterly Season Ticket, the suburban season ticket issued for a period of three months.

q: In container traffic working of Indian Railways, an 'ICD', the dry port where container cargo is handled away from the sea port, stands for:
e: ICD stands for Inland Container Depot, the dry port where container cargo is handled away from the sea port.

q: In Indian Railways, 'CTARA', the academy at Secunderabad which trains the officers of the railway accounts service, stands for:

options.A: Central Training Academy for Railway Administration
options.B: Centralised Training Institute for Railway Accounts
options.C: Centralised Training Academy for Railway Accounts
options.D: Central Academy for Training in Railway Audit

e: CTARA stands for Centralised Training Academy for Railway Accounts, the Secunderabad academy for accounts officers.

q: In Government of India usage, 'MSME' stands for:
e: MSME stands for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in Government of India usage.

q: In social security administration, 'EPFO' stands for:
e: EPFO stands for Employees' Provident Fund Organisation, the social security body for provident fund and pension.

q: In the traction organisation of Indian Railways, a 'PSI', the installation which receives power from the State grid and feeds it to the overhead equipment, stands for:
e: PSI stands for Power Supply Installation, which receives grid power and feeds the overhead equipment.

q: In the transport education sector, 'GSV', the Central University at Vadodara set up under the Ministry of Railways, stands for:
e: GSV stands for Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya, the Central University at Vadodara under the Ministry of Railways.

q: The Habibganj railway station of Bhopal, redeveloped and inaugurated in November 2021 after being renamed as Rani Kamalapati station, is notable as the first railway station in India to be redeveloped under the:
e: Rani Kamalapati station, earlier Habibganj, was India's first station redeveloped under the Public-Private Partnership mode.

q: The first 'Shramik Special' train, run in May 2020 for carrying the migrant workers stranded during the lockdown, was operated from Lingampalli in Hyderabad to:
e: The first Shramik Special of May 2020 ran from Lingampalli in Hyderabad to Hatia, carrying stranded migrant workers.

q: India's first CNG-powered DEMU train service, introduced in January 2015, was run on the section between:
e: India's first CNG-powered DEMU, in January 2015, ran on the Rewari-Rohtak section.

q: India's first solar-powered DEMU train, launched in July 2017, was run from Sarai Rohilla in Delhi to:
e: India's first solar-powered DEMU, launched in July 2017, ran from Sarai Rohilla in Delhi to Farrukhnagar.

q: The first parcel train run from India to Bangladesh, flagged off in July 2020 carrying dry chillies from Guntur in Andhra Pradesh, terminated at:
e: The first parcel train to Bangladesh, carrying dry chillies from Guntur in July 2020, terminated at Benapole.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Himachal Pradesh, flagged off in October 2022, runs between New Delhi and:
e: Himachal Pradesh's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in October 2022, runs between New Delhi and Amb Andaura.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Chhattisgarh, flagged off in December 2022, runs between Bilaspur and:
e: Chhattisgarh's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in December 2022, runs between Bilaspur and Nagpur.

q: The first section of the Chennai Metro, opened for public service in June 2015, was run between Koyambedu and:
e: The first Chennai Metro section, opened in June 2015, ran between Koyambedu and Alandur.

q: The first Vistadome train service of the Kashmir Valley, introduced in October 2023, runs between Srinagar and:
e: The Kashmir Valley's first Vistadome service, introduced in October 2023, runs between Srinagar and Banihal.

q: 'Navdoot', developed by the Banaras Locomotive Works, Varanasi, is the first of Indian Railways of its kind as a:
e: Navdoot, developed by Banaras Locomotive Works, is Indian Railways' first battery-operated dual-mode shunting locomotive.
